enrichment.core_claim: Four physics formalisms can model conscious agent influence on quantum random number generators and estimate the effect sizes needed to match observed deviations.
enrichment.ask_question: Which of the four formalisms required the smallest and most plausible conscious influence to reproduce the data?
enrichment.challenge_question: If the models are tuned to reproduce reported z-scores, how do they avoid assuming the anomalies are real rather than selection or analysis artifacts?
